modeProfiles.playerPromise: Lower expedition pressure, clearer recovery, and no loss of permanent members.
Higher injury and operational pressure without random permanent member loss.
Uses standard opening defaults until explicit custom controls are supplied.
A generous power-fantasy opening that preserves the same deterministic rules.

tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: Committed applicants persist and cannot reroll.

tutorialSteps.shortBody: Sign one applicant and inspect their permanent identity.
tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: Recruitment is a central activity, not a disposable rarity roll.
Equipment changes legal weapon Arts and Forecast behavior.
The game commands Unions, not individual character actions.
Mission and battle rewards visibly build the settlement.

tutorialSteps.shortBody: Assign one permanent member as staff.
tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: Staffing creates opportunity without removing ownership or deployability.
Contracts carry civic, route, character, equipment, and city consequences.
Preparation becomes route choice, risk, events, checks, and camps.

tutorialSteps.shortBody: Visit at least three board nodes.
tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: The board is real gameplay before and between battles.
Character skills and assistance matter, while reload cannot reroll.

tutorialSteps.shortBody: Commit and enter the cinematic Union encounter.
tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: The board defines conditions; the certified battle resolves combat.

tutorialSteps.shortBody: Claim the exact committed equipment reward.
tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: Rewards are satisfying, deterministic, and never auto-equipped.

tutorialSteps.shortBody: Return to the board and finalize the operation.
tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: All progression channels and consequences resolve together.
Relationships grow from shared play and never cost a full day.

tutorialSteps.shortBody: Place or upgrade a second facility and create synergy.
tutorialSteps.whyItMatters: The city becomes a strategic build rather than a list of percentage upgrades.

pacingTargets.evidence: Player understands the living Hall, permanent members, and current priorities.
One applicant is inspected and signed without excessive tutorial interruption.
Player equips recruits and forms two legal Unions.
One facility is placed and its immediate effect is understood.
Player compares and commits one detailed contract.
At least one route choice, event/check, and camp or resource decision occurred.
Certified Union battle completes with readable weapon, Mystic, healing, and Guard behavior.
Reward, manual equip, relationship scene, city growth, save, close, and relaunch are proven.

accessibilityChecks.requirement: Critical state, focus, and warnings remain distinct.
Action identity and consequence remain clear with shorter movement.
No essential information relies on color alone.
Primary controls meet the established touch-size authority.
